text: dsh-ux-plus 是面向 DSH Web 的界面增强插件，在设置页提供 UX Plus 功能开关，并通过浏览器端功能模块改进侧边栏、会话列表、标签页和对话显示。它包含快速提问并把会话收进后台工作区、按活动时间整理工作区与会话、显示 favicon 状态、调整对话字号和宽度、复制会话 ID、选择模型继承对话，以及展开已完成的提问卡片。每项功能可独立开关，设置即时生效；快速提问保存最近 50 条历史。需要可用的 DSH Web 会话、工作区和模型服务；插件没有单独配置 API key。

dsh-ux-plus adds seven UX switches to DSH Web: quick ask, workspace recency, favicon status, adjustable typography, session ID copying, model-based conversation inheritance, and expansion of settled question cards. Quick ask stores recent searches in a background workspace.
想在 DSH 侧边栏直接输入问题并立刻开一个普通会话，不想先创建工作区。
能不能把临时搜索用的会话收起来，平时别出现在工作区列表里？
我想按最近活动整理工作区，并让活跃会话排在历史记录前面。
有没有办法一眼看出哪个会话还在运行、哪个已经完成但没读？
对话文字太小、行太宽，我想分别调整字号和阅读宽度。
我需要从会话菜单复制 session ID，方便之后定位这个会话。
想换个模型继续当前对话，但保留原会话不动。
提问卡片结束后能不能自动展开，让问题和答案直接可见？
I want to ask a quick question in DSH without creating a workspace or naming a session first.
Can I reorder workspace sessions by recent activity and keep older history folded away?
I want the browser tab icon to show when a run is active, unread, or waiting for my input.
dsh-ux-plus 的功能「对话字号与宽度」：在设置中选择五档字号和四档内容宽度，插件将对应 CSS 应用于对话区，并在设置变化时即时更新。
dsh-ux-plus 的功能「复制会话 ID」：从工作区会话行菜单选择 Session ID 项，将当前会话标识复制到剪贴板；浏览器剪贴板不可用时提供兼容复制尝试。
dsh-ux-plus 的功能「工作区最近活动视图」：工作区与会话行按活动时间做视觉排序，并区分活跃和休眠会话；复用宿主展开按钮显示历史，悬停可看最后活动时间。
dsh-ux-plus 的功能「提问卡片自动展开」：监听对话中的 ask_user_question 卡片，卡片结束且仍可展开时点击宿主自己的折叠行，让问题和答案默认可见。
dsh-ux-plus 的功能「选择模型继承对话」：在会话菜单中打开模型选择器；选择后在来源工作区创建新会话、切换到所选模型、发送继承提示并打开新会话。
dsh-ux-plus 的功能「标签页注意力图标」：依据会话状态为宿主鲸鱼 favicon 添加呼吸、未读绿色和待处理橙点提示；状态清空时恢复宿主图标。
dsh-ux-plus 的功能「侧边栏快速提问」：在侧边栏提供输入框，提交后创建普通 DSH 会话并发送问题；可选模型、查看最近 50 条历史并重新打开搜索会话。
dsh-ux-plus 使用主目录下的 .dsh-ux-plus/search 后台工作区，并将快速提问历史及所选模型保存在浏览器 localStorage；工作区和本地存储不可用时相关功能会降级。
dsh-ux-plus 的 README 仍写六项独立开关，且称对话默认字号为 14px；当前源码列出七个开关，字号默认值为 l（16px），请以设置和实际界面为准。

text:
dsh-ux-plus README · Features：| Feature | Interaction detail | Preview | | --- | --- | --- | | **Quick ask** | • Below 【New session】, always one row; yields when the sidebar collapses to the rail
• Type one line, press Enter: an ordinary Session starts — no workspace, no name to invent
• Model: the small icon on the right; leave it alone to follow the host default
• History: the clock icon, last 50 searches, one click back to that Session
• Bubble: one click returns to your newest search Session; a dot lights inside while it runs — green when an answer is unread, amber when a turn waits on you
• Search Sessions stay out of the sidebar; switch the feature off and they come back | | | **Tab attention marker** | • A Session is working: the whale on the tab breathes slowly
• Something finished unseen: the whale turns green, the same green as the list dot
• Something waits for you: an orange dot blinks in the corner
• Neither: the host's own icon comes back; subagents and blank Sessions never light it | — | | **Recency order** | • Sessions running or touched today fold

dsh-ux-plus README · Quick ask：A box sits permanently under **New session** in the sidebar and drops both "create a workspace first" and "start a new session" steps: ask or search right away — type, press Enter, and an ordinary session opens (same UI as any other session) while filing itself into a hidden workspace, out of your sidebar.

dsh-ux-plus README · Quick ask：| Element | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| Input (magnifier on the left) | Enter searches straight away (the field is single-line); an Enter that ends an IME composition never submits by accident |
| Model picker | A small chip icon on the right: click it for the model list (the current pick is ticked). Leave it alone to use the host default; a non-default pick puts a dot on the chip and is remembered locally |
| Session bubble (far right) | Two intents, one control. **Hover** it for history: the last 50 searches, one click reopens that session, one button clears the list; each row carries the same dot — green for an unread answer, amber for a pending question. **Click** it to return to the newest search session, finished or not. While a search is running a dot lights inside the bubble and breathes — never a number. A small corner dot carries the state: **green** = the answer arrived and is unread, **amber** = a turn is waiting for your reply. Dim while there is no search session yet — hovering it still shows the (empty) history |
| Sidebar | Search sessions **never show up** — they all live in the hidden workspace |

dsh-ux-plus README · Quick ask：- The hidden workspace is `.dsh-ux-plus/search` in your home directory, created on first use. It is not in the workspace list and has no group in the session tree, yet the history popup still takes you back to any old search session.
- The box only appears while the sidebar is expanded; in the collapsed rail it steps aside.
- Turning the switch off removes the hidden-workspace rule too — those sessions simply reappear in the sidebar, nothing is lost.

dsh-ux-plus README · Quick ask：Type a question in that box, the icons on the right stay put, Enter opens an ordinary session:

While a search is running, a dot lights up inside the right-hand bubble. Hover the bubble for the history panel; a click returns to the newest search session — finished or not.
dsh-ux-plus README · Attention favicon：The tab icon stays the host's whale. This feature only tints it, breathes it, or adds one dot — and only while there is something to say.

dsh-ux-plus README · Attention favicon：| Tab signal | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| whale **breathes** (slow fade) | any counted session is computing |
| **green whale** | a finished session has not been opened — exactly when the workspace list shows its green dot |
| **blinking orange dot** | something is waiting for your click (approval, question, plan review) |
| plain whale | nothing is up; the host's icon is restored untouched |

dsh-ux-plus README · Attention favicon：The breath has a 35% opacity floor and the blink is asymmetric, so a background tab throttled to ~1 tick/s still shows the alert on whatever frame it freezes on; returning to the tab restarts the cycle from the visible frame. Subagent and blank sessions never light the tab. Both host themes (light / dark) are kept; if the host's whale cannot be re-tinted, the feature quietly does nothing. Switching off leaves no residue.

dsh-ux-plus README · Workspace recency order：Most recent first — the project you were just in stays at the top. Visual order only; the host's sort settings and data are untouched.

**Active block.** Running, or touched within 24 hours: one continuous green-backed band of compact 26px rows, each led by its status dot — orange breathing (awaiting you), blue spinner (running), solid green (finished, unread). A workspace header carries up to three pure-colour dots while that attention is hidden from view; the counts stay in its tooltip.

dsh-ux-plus README · Workspace recency order：**History stays hidden.** No fold bar of its own — the host's own "Expand N more sessions" button is the one control, pinned directly below the Active block. One press opens the section: every row appears, the button returns to the list's native bottom, and the section reads exactly like the host's own expanded list. 收起 folds it back. Closing the whole workspace and opening it again restarts from the fold — the Active block only, never the history.

dsh-ux-plus README · Workspace recency order：
**The ungrouped bucket sinks.** Sessions that belong to no workspace share the 【Ungrouped】 section, which always sits at the very bottom — a fresh, even running, stray session never pushes a workspace down.

dsh-ux-plus README · Workspace recency order：**Idle tidying.** A workspace with no activity for over 24 hours collapses once when the page opens, and shows its age on hover (now / Nm / Nh / Nd). Workspaces holding a running or awaiting session are never auto-collapsed.

dsh-ux-plus README · Workspace recency order：Reordering pauses while your pointer is in the list or a menu is open — and pierces on your own actions: view-option changes and the expand button restyle on the click's own frame. Rows glide (FLIP, off under `prefers-reduced-motion`), zones re-check on a timer so rows fall asleep across the 24-hour line, and a section that briefly sees rows it cannot explain keeps its last consistent look instead of flickering.

dsh-ux-plus README · Conversation typography：The chat area defaults to 14px. Bump the font size and narrow the reading width under **Settings → General → Chat area** — conversation content only, never the whole interface.
dsh-ux-plus README · Session menu: Session ID & Inherit conversation：Each session row's overflow menu gains two items, before the native Pin / Rename entries:
section: Session menu: Session ID & Inherit conversation

text:
dsh-ux-plus README · Session menu: Session ID & Inherit conversation：- **Session ID** — copies the ID to the clipboard, for `--session` resumes and log digging.
- **Inherit conversation** — a model picker opens at the click position. Pick a model and the plugin creates a new session in the same workspace, switches it to that model, posts an inheritance prompt ("summarize and carry on, weighting the latest turns"), and jumps there. The original session is untouched. Good for finishing a long session on a pricier model, or continuing elsewhere when a provider rate-limits.
section: Session menu: Session ID & Inherit conversation

text: dsh-ux-plus README · Ask question expanded：When an `ask_user_question` card finishes, the question and its answer stay expanded — reviewing a decision costs one less click.
dsh-ux-plus README · Settings：**Settings → UX Plus**: six independent switches, on by default, applied instantly.

dsh-ux-plus README · Install：Requires Node.js ≥ 22, pnpm on PATH, and a DSH Web profile.

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <name> add github:plyflai/dsh-ux-plus
```

Restart the profile afterwards. Toggle each feature under **Settings → UX Plus** (on by default, instant). Conversation font size and width live under **Settings → General → Chat area**.

dsh-ux-plus README · Compatibility：- Web UI (browser) only — not the terminal TUI.
- Every feature mounts on public host extension points; no host source is modified, and each feature can be switched off individually.
- Host upgrades may shift internal DOM and slot contracts; file an issue if something breaks.

dsh-ux-plus README · Development：```bash
npm install
npm test        # node --test, incl. static assertions on the built artifact and injected deps
npm run build   # tsdown emits lib/client.js (classic script, committed to the repo)
```

dsh-ux-plus README · Development：- Each feature is a private `features/<name>/` module (host + client halves) registered in the feature lists of `src/index.js` and `src/switches.js` — not a standalone plugin.
- The client bundles into a single classic script injected into `window.__ModuleLoader__`; external dependencies are strictly limited to the module seeds the host provides, enforced by the build script.
- Every push to main appends one entry to the update log below and syncs [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md).

dsh-ux-plus README · 直接问：侧边栏【新建会话】下方常驻一个输入框，省掉「先建工作区、新建一个会话」这两步：想到什么就直接问、直接搜——输入、回车，开的是一个普通会话（界面和普通会话完全一致），会话自己收进隐藏工作区，不占侧边栏。

| 元素 | 行为 |
| --- | --- |
| 输入框（放大镜在左） | 回车直接搜索（单行输入框）；输入法选词时的回车不会误提交 |
| 模型选择器 | 右侧一枚小图标（芯片），点开就是模型列表（当前项打勾）；不改就用宿主默认模型；选了非默认模型时图标带一个小圆点，并记在本机 |
| 会话气泡（最右） | 一个控件两种意图：**悬停**弹历史——最近 50 次搜索，点一条直接回到那次会话，可一键清空，每条前面同样有点（绿＝跑完没看，橙＝等你回复）；**点击**回到最近那个搜索会话——跑没跑完都能回。有搜索正在跑时气泡里亮起一个点并轻微呼吸，没有数字；右上角还会带一个小圆点：**绿**＝回答完了还没看，**橙**＝正在等你回复；还没有搜索会话时是暗的、点不动——悬停仍会弹出空历史 |
| 侧边栏 | 搜索会话**不出现**——它们都在隐藏工作区里 |

dsh-ux-plus README · 直接问：- 隐藏工作区在你主目录下（`.dsh-ux-plus/search`），首次使用自动创建；它不进工作区列表、不进会话树，但历史弹窗能把你带回任何一个旧会话。
- 输入框只在侧边栏展开时出现；侧边栏收成窄栏（rail）时它自己让位。
- 关掉这个开关，隐藏工作区的规则一起撤掉——那些会话会照常出现在侧边栏里，不丢东西。

输入、回车，就是一次搜索会话：

搜索在跑时，最右那个气泡里亮起一个点；悬停它弹出历史面板，点它回到最近那个搜索会话——跑完、答案出来了，也还是这一下。

dsh-ux-plus README · 标签页注意力指示灯：图标仍是宿主的白鲸——本功能只在有事时给它上色、让它呼吸、或加一颗点。

| 标签页在说 | 含义 |
| --- | --- |
| 白鲸**呼吸**（缓慢渐隐渐显） | 任意被统计的会话在计算 |
| **绿鲸** | 有跑完的会话还没被打开——与工作区列表的绿点严格一致 |
| **橙点闪烁** | 有东西在等你点（审批、提问、计划确认） |
| 原样白鲸 | 什么事都没有；宿主图标原样还回去 |

呼吸有 35% 透明度下限、闪烁刻意不对称，后台标签页被节流到约每秒一跳时提醒依然可见；切回标签页的瞬间从可见帧重启周期。子代理与空会话永不点亮标签页。明暗两套主题都保留；染不了色时静默不做事。关掉开关不留残留。

dsh-ux-plus README · 最近活动排序：最近聊过的排最前，回到刚才的项目不用翻。只改视觉顺序，宿主的排序设置与数据不动。

**Active 区。** 运行中、或 24 小时内动过的会话，收进一整块连续的淡绿底：26px 紧凑行，行首是状态点——橙色呼吸（等你回复）、蓝色转圈（运行中）、绿色实心（跑完没看）。工作区标题用最多三颗纯色点提示被藏住的注意力，计数在 tooltip 里。

**历史整体隐藏。** 不加自己的折叠行——宿主的【展开其余 N 个会话】就是唯一入口，钉在 Active 块正下方。点一次展开：每一行出现，按钮回到列表最下方，看起来和宿主原生展开一模一样；点【收起】再次折回。收起整个工作区再打开，也回到折叠态：只展开 Active 区，历史不会跟着一起回来。

dsh-ux-plus README · 最近活动排序：
**未分组沉底。** 没有归属工作区的会话统一收在【未分组】里，永远压在列表最下方——哪怕它刚聊过、甚至正在运行，也不会把工作区往下挤。 **闲置瘦身。** 超过 24 小时没动的工作区在打开页面时自动收起一次，悬停显示距今时间（刚刚 / N分钟 / N小时 / N天）。有运行中或待回复会话的工作区不会被自动收起。
dsh-ux-plus README · 最近活动排序：重排不跟你抢鼠标：指针在列表里或有菜单打开时暂停，而你自己的操作（切视图选项、点展开按钮）在点击当帧直接重绘。行位置带短促滑翔（`prefers-reduced-motion` 下关闭），分区按定时心跳重算（跨过 24 小时线自动入眠），宿主渲染竞态下保持上一次自洽的样子、不闪。
dsh-ux-plus README · 对话字号与宽度：对话区默认 14px。在 **设置 → 通用 → 对话区** 单独调大字号、收窄阅读宽度——只作用于会话内容，不改整个界面。

dsh-ux-plus README · 会话菜单：复制会话 ID 与继承对话：每个会话行的三点菜单追加两项（在置顶、重命名等原生项之前）：

- **会话 ID** — 一键复制到剪贴板，用于 `--session` 续接、日志定位。
- **继承对话** — 点击位置弹出模型选择浮层。选定后：同工作区新建会话、切到所选模型、投递继承提示词（总结并接着推进，越近的轮次权重越高）、自动跳过去。原会话完全不受影响。适合长会话换更贵的模型收尾、或提供方限流时换条路继续。

dsh-ux-plus README · 设置：**设置 → UX Plus**：六项功能独立开关，默认全开，切换即时生效。

dsh-ux-plus README · 安装：需要 Node.js ≥ 22、PATH 中的 pnpm，以及一个 DSH Web profile。

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <name> add github:plyflai/dsh-ux-plus
```

安装后重启该 profile。开关在 **设置 → UX Plus**（默认开启、即时生效）；对话字号和宽度在 **设置 → 通用 → 对话区**。

dsh-ux-plus README · 兼容性：- 仅面向 DSH 的 **Web 界面**（浏览器），不适用于终端 TUI。
- 所有功能都挂在宿主公开扩展点上，不修改宿主源码；任何一项都可单独关闭。
- 宿主升级可能调整内部 DOM 与插槽契约；如遇失效请提 issue。

dsh-ux-plus README · 开发：```bash
npm install
npm test        # node --test，含构建产物与注入依赖的静态断言
npm run build   # tsdown 产出 lib/client.js（经典脚本，随仓库提交）
```

- 每个功能是一个 `features/<name>/` 私有模块（host + client 两半），在 `src/index.js` 与 `src/switches.js` 的功能清单里注册，不是独立插件。
- 客户端资源打包为单个经典脚本注入 `window.__ModuleLoader__`，外部依赖严格限制在宿主提供的模块种子内，构建脚本会校验。
- 每次推送到 main 会在下方更新记录追加一条，并同步 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)。
